# Lockheed Martin Receives $1.9 Billion PAC-3 MSE Production Contract

BETHESDA, Md., Sept. 15, 2026 -- Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE: LMT) received a $1.9 billion contract from the U.S. Army for PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement interceptor production, the largest PAC-3 MSE award to date. Deliveries under the contract are scheduled through 2029.

The award follows the company's plan to expand annual PAC-3 MSE production capacity to 650 interceptors in 2027.
